title: Fatima Jinnah's birth chart
metaDescription: Fatima Jinnah's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 8.3° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 8.3° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 8.3° Leo: the first decan, whose classical sub-ruler is the Sun. A fire sign, read here in its first face.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Leo (21.7°), Venus in Virgo (2.4°), Mars in Leo (19.7°): a mind that decides at speaking speed, taste for the substantial and the lasting, drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts the Sun a sixth of the circle apart from Saturn, 0.0° off exact. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, the Sun square Uranus at 1.5°, and Mercury conjunction Mars at 2.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Three planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Sun in Leo at 8.3° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Virgo at 2.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Saturn in Libra at 8.3° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: fire 3, air 3, water 2, earth 2 across the elements, and fixed 5, mutable 4, cardinal 1 across the modalities. Mercury was retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.0° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 7.4°.
